Markets.title: Zerodha unit gets nod for merchant banking
Markets.summary: Zerodha Corporate Advisors received approval from Sebi on September 1 to operate as a merchant banker. This authorization allows the firm to manage initial public offerings and other capital market activities as registration finalizes.

Markets.title: IPO Boom: 10 issues cross 100x subscription in August, highest monthly tally since 2006
Markets.summary: In August, ten initial public offerings were oversubscribed by more than 100 times, led by Hy-Tech Engineers at over 244 times. This record-breaking monthly tally has positioned 2026 as a standout year for IPO activity.

Markets.title: US stocks today: US markets rebound from lows, but inflation, Iran war worries persist
Markets.summary: US stocks rebounded from a three-day selloff, with the S&P 500, Nasdaq, and Dow all ending higher. However, persistent inflation, global bond losses, escalating US-Iran tensions, and weak jobs data kept investors cautious.

Markets.title: Small finance banks' asset quality to improve, GNPA to drop by 120 basis points by March 2027: Crisil
Markets.summary: Crisil projects that small finance banks will see their gross non-performing assets drop by 120 basis points by March 2027. This anticipated improvement in asset quality is driven by the recovery of microfinance portfolios, stable non-microfinance growth, and tighter underwriting practices.

Markets.title: Insurers plan floor for fire cover to avoid large burns
Markets.summary: Indian non-life insurers are considering setting a minimum rate for the natural catastrophe component of fire insurance. This initiative aims to prevent heavy losses caused by aggressive pricing, steep discounts, and recent fire incidents in Gujarat.

Markets.title: 'Revolver' misfire hits credit card issuers: India's credit card boom sees lower bank profits
Markets.summary: Indian banks are experiencing lower credit card profits because customers are using cards more for payments and less for borrowing. This decline in interest-bearing balances is impacting major lenders like HDFC Bank and SBI Cards, with analysts predicting further margin reductions.

Geo-Political.title: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says
Geo-Political.summary: Saudi Arabia stated that an Iranian attack on a Saudi oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz killed two Filipino sailors. The kingdom condemned the strike, which involved unknown projectiles hitting the vessel on Monday.

Geo-Political.title: Protests in Spain over government's handling of Ceuta migrant crisis
Geo-Political.summary: Spanish opposition parties are protesting Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's handling of the migrant crisis in Ceuta. Critics accuse the Prime Minister of abandoning the local residents during the situation.

Geo-Political.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
Geo-Political.summary: Following a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport, Berlin blamed Russia for the incident. In response, the EU and NATO have pledged to increase pressure on Moscow over this new escalation.

Geo-Political.title: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
Geo-Political.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin recently issued a veiled threat directed at the United Kingdom. According to analyst Steve Rosenberg, this warning is part of an ongoing Russian campaign designed to cause stress and uncertainty in the West.

Geo-Political.title: Watch: Jury still unable to reach unanimous decision in Lindsay Clancy case
Geo-Political.summary: Jurors in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial informed the judge for the second time in two days that they cannot reach a unanimous verdict. The jury remains deadlocked regarding the outcome of the case.

Geo-Political.title: Maltese tycoon acquitted of orchestrating murder of renowned journalist
Geo-Political.summary: A Maltese tycoon accused of masterminding the 2017 car bomb assassination of investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia has been acquitted. Caruana Galizia was killed after exposing high-level corruption and money laundering schemes in Malta.

AI & Tech.summary: A content creator tested ChatGPT to see if their WordPress SaaS course would be recommended without paid advertising. The AI unexpectedly listed their course as the top recommendation, demonstrating a shift toward AI-driven traffic.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transformed from a file-sharing service into a generative AI platform for content creation. The platform allows users to generate, share, and monetize their AI-created content.

Data & Insights.title: BJP Vs Congress: ‘Not comparing apples with apples?’ Piyush Goyal hits back at Congress criticism of GDP numbers
Data & Insights.summary: Union Minister Piyush Goyal defended India's latest GDP growth numbers against criticism from the Congress party. Recent data shows India's economy grew faster than expected, demonstrating resilience amid concerns over the US-Iran war.

Data & Insights.title: How a stalled mall in Srinagar fetched a massive amount in auction - more than double govt expectation
Data & Insights.summary: An abandoned mall property in Srinagar was auctioned on August 25 and 26. The highest bid reached ₹421.75 crore on a full-lease basis, more than double the government's expectation.

Data & Insights.title: '7.8% growth but still import-dependent': Sridhar Vembu explains Modi’s Swadeshi push
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India revised its fiscal year 2027 GDP growth forecast to 6.7%, while Prime Minister Modi highlighted a 7.8% real GDP growth in the first quarter. Emphasizing the country's continued import dependence, Modi urged citizens to boost local consumption and avoid non-essential spending to conserve foreign exchange.

Data & Insights.title: Why a sovereign rating is not the last word on a nation’s creditworthiness
Data & Insights.summary: Sovereign credit ratings are composite measures of a country's ability to service its debt rather than badges of national prestige. Analyzing their multiple dimensions provides a more useful assessment of a nation's true creditworthiness.

Data & Insights.title: Tamil Nadu CM Joseph Vijay will be in UK from September 10 to 16 - What's on the agenda?
Data & Insights.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay will visit the United Kingdom from September 10 to 16. Additionally, a state delegation led by Minister Keerthana will travel to Taiwan on September 4 for the Semicon conference.

India.title: 2 Unidentified Gunmen Open Fire At Solan In Punjab's Mohali, Case Filed
India.summary: Two unidentified motorcycle-borne gunmen fired several rounds at a salon in Punjab's Mohali. Police have filed a case regarding the incident.

India.title: 3 Killed, Over 16,000 Evacuated As Flood Situation Worsens In UP
India.summary: Floods in Uttar Pradesh have killed 3 people and forced the evacuation of over 16,000 residents to safety. Authorities rescued 3,042 of these individuals on Wednesday as severe conditions continued across parts of the state.

India.title: Ayodhya Ram Temple Gets Air Force Veteran As CEO, 3 New Members
India.summary: Air Marshal Mishra, a retired Indian Air Force fighter pilot with over 38 years of service, has been appointed as the CEO of the Ayodhya Ram Temple. Along with his appointment, three new members have also joined the temple administration.

India.title: Delhi High Court Fines Firm For Demoting Woman After Maternity Leave
India.summary: The Delhi High Court fined a company for demoting a female employee after she returned from maternity leave. The court ruled that women coming back from maternity leave must generally be reinstated to their previous positions.

India.title: 6 IAS Officers Among 19 Chargesheeted In Rs 504-Crore Scam In Haryana
India.summary: Haryana authorities have chargesheeted 19 individuals, including six IAS officers and several bank officials, in connection with a Rs 504-crore scam. The latest chargesheet also names nine other state government officials involved in the financial irregularities.

India.title: Ex-Chief Economic Adviser Backs GDP Data, Calls Methodology "Cutting-Edge"
India.summary: Former Chief Economic Adviser Krishnamurthy V Subramanian has defended India's GDP calculation methodology as cutting-edge. He also rejected opposition claims that the government intentionally manipulated past GDP data to artificially boost this year's growth figures.

General.title: Burnham pressed on economy at first PMQs as borrowing costs surge
General.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham faced questions from Kemi Badenoch about the economy during his first Prime Minister's Questions as borrowing costs surged. He responded by stating that his government would remain "grounded in fiscal responsibility."

General.title: Faisal Islam: Why bond market wildfire is keeping world leaders up at night
General.summary: Massive artificial intelligence spending and the ongoing war in Iran are causing global borrowing costs to rise. This surge in bond market yields is causing significant concern for world leaders.

General.title: King hails 'unprecedented' Bayeux Tapestry exhibition in London
General.summary: The British King praised an unprecedented exhibition of the historic Bayeux Tapestry in London. British and French leaders attended the British Museum to view the historic artifact.

General.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
General.summary: Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport, citing growing recklessness. In response, the EU and NATO vowed to increase pressure on Russia following this new escalation.

General.summary: The ride-hailing app has launched 15 self-driving taxis, but they will have safety drivers inside.
